title: Unified adapter lifecycle and receipt schemas

acceptance.reasoner_reviewer_executor_roles_metadat: roles is declarative metadata (enum array) on adapter.v1; the control plane never infers roles from behavior
acceptance.no_global_completion_field: no property of adapter.v1 or adapter-receipt.v1 carries a global completion; attempt outcome is per-attempt and evidence-backed (attempt_outcome.state enum, evidence_bundle_id binding)
acceptance.capability_snapshot_and_cancel_recover_t: capability_snapshot is a typed object with digest binding; cancel and recover are typed lifecycle objects plus lifecycle_state enum including CANCELLING/CANCELLED/RECOVERING

protocol_tests.rule: unknown receipt kinds and global completion fields fail closed
